hints: Look at line 5 of calc.sh: result=$(( n * 2 )). $(( )) evaluates its operand as an arithmetic EXPRESSION, and that evaluation is recursive.

If n is 'a[$(id -u)]', bash parses it as an array reference — and an array subscript is command-substituted, so the command inside actually runs before the multiplication happens. ShellCheck has no warning for this at all.

Write answers.txt with line=5, flaw=arith-cmdsub, and fix=... naming numeric validation before (( )).
